text:
Maya: Partner sent new private offer proposal: $1.2M commit over 12mo + variable onboarding kicker for SI. They want instant activation and a guaranteed renewal price collar. Ops/Legal/Finance input?

Rafi: Instant activation = risk. Recommend a 14-day soft-onboard window: enable 30% of committed throughput first, then unlock weekly blocks after health checks.

Sergio: From infra: we need per-offer soft-quotas, a fallback policy to public-tier models, and automated alerts when cluster reserved capacity >70%. Also suggest `onboard_unlock_schedule` and `health_check_pass` flags.

Nina: Legal: renewal collar ok but limit to max 8% uplift protection and require explicit KPI thresholds (e.g., normalized consumption growth). Also include audit and dispute window. Will draft clause.

Maya: SI kicker — partner wants it paid upfront. We prefer milestone-based: 40% on signed PO, 40% on first customer go-live, 20% after 90d verified usage. Non-transferable credits, 12mo expiry.

mp-bot: Query: SELECT offer_id, committed, used_30d, activation_notice_days FROM mp_private_offers WHERE partner='nova-hw' ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1;
Result: offer_id=nh-2026-03, committed=1200000, used_30d=350000, activation_notice_days=0

Rafi: used_30d=350k -> ~29% monthly burn; safe for phased activation. We'll propose: day0=30% enabled, wk1=+30%, wk2=rest. Health checks: latency P95 < 400ms and no autoscale errors.

Sergio: Add circuit-breaker: if Dedicated_saturation>82% for 1h -> auto-fallback + partner steward ping + escalate to oncall. Implement `circuit_breaker_threshold` and `circuit_breaker_window` fields.

Nina: For renewal collar: require LOI signed within 45 days post-term and consumption >=60% of commit; otherwise collar void. I'll include exact wording.

Maya: Finance: propose holding 3% of committed value as security until 30 days after first activation to cover sudden churn or disputes. OK?

mp-bot: Heads-up: scheduled infra maintenance 05:30 UTC tomorrow may affect Dedicated autoscale for ~20m.

Rafi: We'll avoid heavy unlocks during maintenance window. Also add console visibility: per-offer "onboard stage" and next unlock ETA so partner PM sees progress.

Sergio: Backlog: minimal API + UI for flags + circuit-breaker banner ~ 6 dev-days. Add runbook P1.

Maya: Action items:
- Nina: draft renewal collar + SI kicker clauses (EOD)
- Rafi: define health-check pass criteria and onboarding schedule (tomorrow)
- Sergio: scope circuit-breaker implementation + ETA (2d)
- Maya: schedule partner alignment Thurs 9am PT and include maintenance window note

Nina: Will add non-refund credit policy and dispute escrow language.

Maya: Thanks team. Aim to present a single counter with phased activation and milestone SI credits. :white_check_mark:
